title: On Postponing the meeting until the spring
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：postpone　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 postpone 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the gardener ① postponed the meeting until the spring year after year, and every apprentice in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the gardener ② postpones the meeting until the spring for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ postpone the meeting until the spring at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ postponed the meeting until the spring before — a line in the notebook for April 1974 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Postponing the meeting until the spring year after year, the gardener said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ postpone the case for three short weeks for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Postpone the case for three short weeks at once and never mention it again.

By 1987 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new apprentice from the next garden ⑧ postpones the case for three short weeks year after year every spring without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ postponed the meeting until the spring again when nobody else would.

⑩ To postpone the meeting until the spring, my mother said in 1992, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody postpones the meeting until the spring for the whole place again and somebody must postpone the meeting until the spring year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 推迟（一般过去式 postponed the meeting until the spring：1980 年园丁头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 推迟（一般现在 postpones the meeting until the spring：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 推迟（不定式 to postpone the meeting until the spring：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 推迟（过去完成时 had postponed the meeting until the spring：1974 年四月的园艺笔记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 推迟（动名词 postponing the meeting until the spring 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 缓办（postpone the case for three short weeks：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去缓办把那桩案子缓办三个星期）
G. v. 缓办（postpone the case for three short weeks：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 推迟（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 postpones the case for three short weeks，而母亲又一次 postponed the meeting until the spring）

answers.why: postpone 意为“推迟”，1980 年园丁年年地推迟把会期推到开春，那是园子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 postponed。
postpone 意为“推迟”，自那以后园丁替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 postpones。
postpone 意为“推迟”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯推迟把会期推到开春”，此处为不定式 to postpone the meeting until the spring。
postpone 意为“推迟”，园艺笔记里 四月 那行字说明早在 1987 年之前就有人推迟过，故用过去完成时 had postponed。
postpone 意为“推迟”，园丁说“推迟把会期推到开春这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 postponing the meeting until the spring 作主语。
postpone 意为“缓办”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去缓办把那桩案子缓办三个星期”，should ever 之后用原形 postpone the case for three short weeks。
postpone 意为“缓办”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻缓办把那桩案子缓办三个星期（postpone the case for three short weeks at once），以后再也不要提起。
postpone 意为“推迟”，新来的学徒每个春天都照例缓办把那桩案子缓办三个星期，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 postpones。
postpone 意为“推迟”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地推迟把会期推到开春，用一般过去式 postponed 叙述。
postpone 意为“推迟”，结尾那句是母亲 1992 年的话：要推迟把会期推到开春，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和园子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 postpone 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the gardener postponed the meeting until the spring year after year, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the gardener postpones the meeting until the spring for the whole place whenever the garden asks.
Postponing the meeting until the spring year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever postpone the case for three short weeks for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next garden postpones the case for three short weeks year after year every spring, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother postponed the meeting until the spring again, and the garden remembered that half.
